title: Portobello Penne Pasta Casserole
description: Portabello mushrooms, spinach, cheeses and penne combine to make a delicious casserole dish - perfect for family dinners or a party.
ingredients: 1 (10 ounce) package frozen chopped spinach, thawed

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Lightly grease a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Place pasta in the pot, cook for 8 to 10 minutes, until al dente, and drain.

Heat the oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Stir in the mushrooms, cook 1 minute, and set aside. Melt margarine in the saucepan. Mix in flour, garlic, and basil. Gradually mix in milk until thickened. Stir in 1 cup cheese until melted. Remove saucepan from heat, and mix in cooked pasta, mushrooms, spinach, and soy sauce. Transfer to the prepared baking dish, and top with remaining cheese.
Bake 20 minutes in the preheated oven, until bubbly and lightly brown.

video.description: Great pasta begins right at home, and you’ll love how easy it is to make this rich, creamy dish. Cook penne pasta, then make a delicious sauce with Portobello mushrooms, garlic, basil, milk and mozzarella cheese. Mix together pasta with mushroom sauce, chopped spinach and soy sauce. Bake for twenty minutes, and when it’s bubbly and fragrant, serve it up. Rave reviews will put this casserole recipe on your regular rotation!
